concurrency.note: Sections are processed concurrently by the wrapper using the parent's own per-section functions; all aggregation is still done by the parent on cache hits.

cost_report.note: Cost of this run's artifacts, recomputed from per-call records. Stages listed in stages_reused_from_an_earlier_run were computed under an earlier run_key and copied in unchanged; their cost is included here because they are part of this result.

request_audit.note: sha256 of the system prompt and of the full outbound payload per distinct request; the rendered prompt set is in prompts/rendered.json
